Chapter 1195 - 14 Fierce Sun’S Grand Cycle (Subscription Requested)

Chapter 1195: Chapter 14 Fierce Sun’s Grand Cycle (Subscription Requested)

"This strike?"

Red Flame Venerable’s expression was solemn. As an observer, though he did not directly face the power of Lin Yuan’s Time-Space Blade, he could feel a thing or two.

Just a single strike from the Time-Space Blade caused some injury to Red Lotus Venerable. Now with three hundred and thirty-three blades attacking simultaneously, for Red Lotus Venerable to block them, he would probably need to reveal his true methods.

"The Galaxy Venerate is not weak in rule comprehension either."

Venerable Hengyang came to some conclusions. Comprehension of the Ninth Realm of Time-Space is considered normal among the Peak Venerables, but among the royal bloodline that only knows to excavate bloodlines?

It’s already extremely exaggerated.

Basically at the highest level under the rule of chaos evolution power.

"Hahaha, good, good, good!"

The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country saw this scene, and a smile immediately appeared on his face.

Originally, he was worried about how Lin Yuan could last a hundred breaths against Red Lotus Venerable.

After all, Red Lotus Venerable’s methods primarily focus on quick battles.

The Red Lotus Karma Fire ignores defense, and ordinary Venerables find it difficult to last a hundred breaths under such flames.

But now?

Looking at this situation, it’s no longer a question of whether Lin Yuan can last a hundred breaths, but rather which of these two Venerables will win in the end.

"Endless Red Lotus!"

Facing three hundred and thirty-three Time-Space Blades, Red Lotus Venerable was like facing a great enemy, his physical form once again dispersing and transforming into countless Red Lotus Karma Fire, floating amidst time and space.

Whizz!

Whizz!

Whizz!!!

The three hundred and thirty-three Time-Space Blades slashed forth, and the vast spaces began to shatter. The floating Red Lotus Karma Fire amidst time and space also felt the impact.

Yet, relying on its own void attribute, it managed to barely withstand the three hundred and thirty-three Time-Space Blades.

After the three hundred and thirty blades, Red Lotus Venerable’s figure once again coalesced.

"Hmm?"

Seeing this, Lin Yuan immediately prepared to strike again.

"Galaxy Venerate, there’s no need to keep fighting."

Red Lotus Venerable immediately said.

With the current strength Lin Yuan exhibited, it was only natural for someone to last a hundred breaths in his hands.

Furthermore, given the current degree of their fight, if they were to continue, Red Lotus Venerable would have to use those real deadly methods.

But such methods are meant for enemies, and Red Lotus Venerable naturally didn’t want to use them on a fellow Venerable.

"Chi Yan, what do you think?"

Red Lotus Venerable looked toward the distant Red Flame Venerable.

It was initially Red Flame Venerable’s idea to have him test the Galaxy Venerate’s strength.

"Indeed, there’s no need to keep fighting."

Red Flame Venerable nodded. The reason he had Red Lotus Venerable make a move was to increase the chances of vying for that top-class territory.

As long as Lin Yuan’s strength reached the threshold of Peak Venerate, and he didn’t hold back in the contest, Red Flame Venerable would turn a blind eye.

And now, the strength Lin Yuan revealed not only didn’t hold them back but was a pleasant surprise.

Although Red Flame Venerable also coveted that top-class territory, he even more so hoped that the territory would be occupied by the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, and everything he did was based on the interests of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

"Alright."

Lin Yuan nodded, retracting the Divine Ability ’World.’

This Divine Skill, which merged and devoured the source of the Fierce Sun, emitted a strong Fierce Sun aura. Even if he said he hadn’t excavated the Ancestor’s bloodline to the Venerate level, no one would believe it.

"The strength of the Galaxy Venerate?"

"Terrifying, feels no weaker than Red Lotus Venerable?"

"Is this the Venerate-level Ancestor Bloodline? Unprecedented?"

"Even a Venerate-level Ancestor Bloodline requires a lot of time to excavate. How long has it been since the Galaxy Venerate transformed his bloodline to the Venerate level?"

"Freakish, absolutely freakish."

The other ancient Venerables present were full of shock, and they too felt the terror of Lin Yuan.

Initially, the Venerables were quite dissatisfied with the Emperor’s decision, believing that forcibly inserting the Galaxy Venerate into the Venerate quota was entirely the Emperor pulling strings.

But now?

Even if Lin Yuan wasn’t a core member of the royal family, solely relying on his strength to compete for one of the twelve Venerate seats, he would still fully be able to compete for it.

The Emperor’s involvement in getting Lin Yuan into the Venerate list was truly icing on the cake.

"Galaxy Venerate..."

Among the many Venerables, Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate looked at Lin Yuan in astonishment.

He had previous interactions with Lin Yuan and was the previous guardian of the Hei Yu Nest.

At that time, Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate did not make things difficult for Lin Yuan to take over the Hei Yu Nest, but instead, was quick to yield it, as he did not want to offend this core royal family member.

In Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate’s view, Lin Yuan’s future potential was immense.

He found it entirely unnecessary to offend fate over a bit of Hei Yu.

Looking at it now.

Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate was immensely grateful for his past decision.

How long has it been? The Galaxy Venerate already possesses such strength?

At this moment.

Lin Yuan and the Red Lotus Venerate flew toward the numerous venerates.

"Galaxy Venerate." The Red Lotus Venerate looked at Lin Yuan, genuinely admiring him: "I always believed that the rules of the Dao were fundamental. Now it seems that the extremity of Bloodline Power is by no means inferior to the power of the Dao rules."

When he sparred with Lin Yuan, from start to finish, the latter never utilized deeply profound Dao rule insights. On the contrary, the Red Lotus Venerate used the path of power evolution through Chaos—the Red Lotus Karma Fire burned Lin Yuan’s body, flesh, and soul.

"To reach the level of an Ancestor, one still must rely on Dao rules," Lin Yuan said.

Although the Fierce Sun bloodline is a thirteenth-level bloodline, wanting to reach the thirteenth level by following this bloodline is utterly impossible.

To step into the thirteenth level, one must forcibly forge their own path of Chaos Power evolution, breaking through the limitations of time loops.

"How easy is it to reach the level of an Ancestor?" The Red Lotus Venerate shook his head. Throughout the long ages of the Origin World, only six entities truly became Ancestors and established an Ancient Country.

"Alright, Galaxy Venerate, you needn’t be modest." The Chi Yan Venerate said from the side, "With your strength, it’s only a matter of time before you surpass us."

Not to mention the potential excavation of the Ancestral bloodline’s future, merely relying on Lin Yuan’s current strength, if he could comprehend a path of Chaos evolution rules, even if only the first level, his strength would be about the same as his, the Chi Yan Venerate.

And with Lin Yuan’s insight into time and space, comprehending a path of Chaos Power evolution isn’t something unimaginable.

Lin Yuan listened quietly. His current strength is roughly on par with the Red Lotus Venerate. If he really fought with all his might, Lin Yuan wasn’t confident he could win.

As for comparing with the Chi Yan Venerate? He was obviously not as good.

The strength of the Chi Yan Venerate, even placed in the Chaos Void, is close to the level of an Invincible Great Saint, stronger than both the Hunxiao Heavenly Venerate and the Jade Qilin Venerable.

"But the fight for the first-rate treasured land is right before us. When battling with venerates from other Ancient Countries, it won’t be as easy as it is now..." The Chi Yan Venerate hinted.

"Understood."

Lin Yuan nodded.

He understood what the Chi Yan Venerate meant.

The sparring between Lin Yuan and the Red Lotus Venerate ended quickly, and neither side was almost injured because neither had used their true offensive means.

When it really comes to battling with enemy venerates in order to seize a first-rate treasured land, those Peak Venerates might even risk their primary battle bodies.

The intensity of such battles would be nothing like simple sparring as before.

"Alright, Galaxy, you go ahead and rest."

The emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country spoke: "Head to that treasured land in ten years."

"Mhm."

Lin Yuan nodded.

He disappeared from where he stood.

"The future of our Fierce Sun Ancient Country..." The Chi Yan Venerate looked at the place where Lin Yuan had disappeared, feeling a slight hint of anticipation in his heart.

Compared to the ownership of that first-rate treasured land, he was more eager about what height Lin Yuan’s future could reach.

...

Galaxy Royal Mansion.

After returning, Lin Yuan continued his cultivation insights.

The sparring with the Red Lotus Venerate made him clearly understand the general level of his strength, belonging to the level of a seasoned Peak Venerate, yet not as good as the top Peak Venerates.

"First-rate treasured land."

Lin Yuan was quite eager in his heart. The battle for the first-rate treasured land wasn’t just for the benefits inside, but also intended to give back to the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

After all, having descended to the Fierce Sun Ancient Country for so many years, Lin Yuan had basically benefited greatly from this Ancient Country, so naturally, he wanted to repay it in some way.

"My current strength is only enough not to hold back in the battle for the treasured land; it’s still too weak."

Lin Yuan thought silently, simultaneously focusing part of his mind on comprehending his inheritance of the ’Fierce Sun, Xuanyin, Chaos’.

Traveling between various great domains of the Xuanyin Ancient Country, his avatars comprehended the blood essence of many Xuanyin Venerables, experiencing the Xuanyin Dao contained within.

As for Lin Yuan’s true form in the royal mansion, he began to comprehend the ’Fierce Sun Chapter’ in the inheritance.

Lin Yuan already had the Fierce Sun bloodline flowing within him, and being situated around the great Yang vein of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, the Fierce Sun Dao lay sprawling, making comprehension effortlessly.

[Your enlightenment is extraordinary, enhancing your understanding of the Fierce Sun Dao...]

In a trance, Lin Yuan’s mind and consciousness began to ascend infinitely, suddenly arriving at a World of Flames filled with endless Fierce Suns.

"Is this the place?"

Lin Yuan glanced around, feeling very familiar with this place. Once he gathered enough Seeds of the Fierce Sun, he could freely enter this mysterious Fierce Sun world.

"Hmm?"

Lin Yuan detected something amiss with just a glance around.

Compared to when he previously entered this World of Flames, his position this time was different.

"It’s much higher."

Lin Yuan carefully observed the surroundings and reached a conclusion.

"Ancestor of Fierce Sun."

Lin Yuan raised his head, looking at the imposing figure standing with hands behind on the highest point of the world. Due to the elevation, the figure Lin Yuan saw was much clearer, allowing to detect all sorts of subtle auras.

After observing for a while, Lin Yuan benefited greatly and quickly withdrew, as it was impossible to stay long in that World of Flames, lest there be a risk of being assimilated.

As his mind consciousness returned to his physical body, Lin Yuan’s expression changed.

Inside his body, vast and expansive, countless Seeds of the Fierce Sun floated like miniature Fierce Suns, numbering thirty-three thousand three hundred thirty-two in total.

At this moment, the thirty-three thousand three hundred thirty-third Fierce Sun Seed quickly took shape, condensed in an instant.

The moment this Seed of the Fierce Sun appeared, it formed an entire entity with the preceding thirty-three thousand three hundred thirty-two Seeds, akin to a complete great Fierce Sun cycle.

Boom!!!
